flags: PIN WRONG: stored 42.11869,-94.02098 is on a different peninsula, about 600 m NW of the campgrounds. Corrected 42.1140,-94.0170, between campgrounds A, B and C (county campground map matched to imagery). Elevation there 335 m (Open-Meteo), the same as stored. The stored lakeview call was read at the wrong pin.

WATERFRONT LEAD UP: lakeview -> lakefront at Campground B's west row. Imagery (0.21 m/px, 42.1140,-94.0187): pads fan off B's spine toward the lake with about 35-40 m of open grass then a thin brush band to the shore, no road, driveway or day use between; only a small dock. Campground A is lakeview at best: its west lane sits between pads and the shore, about 35-50 m. C is inland. No photo read; the canopy is thin but a site photo would confirm the sightline.
BOOKING CONFLICT: county page and MyCountyParks say A and B reservable, C FCFS; the county's campground map says only A reservable. Recorded in booking.note, not resolved.
SITE COUNT CONFLICT: 150+30 on the county page, 135+27 on MyCountyParks. Took the county's own page; both in sites.note.
FEE: the $12 non-electric sites aren't described (6 group areas also exist), so whether a 23-ft motorhome fits is unstated; low stays 20. If they fit, low is 12.
